# spec-004 T0 — copy preservation snapshot
#
# Literal, user-facing strings from the three files named in spec-004's
# "Copy preservation" contract, extracted BEFORE any spec-004 source edit.
# Existing strings below must remain byte-identical after the restyle, even
# if moved between widgets or files. Interpolated (`${...}`) literals are
# recorded as their fixed surrounding segments (same convention as
# strings_003_before.txt).
#
# Non-negotiable per spec.md: the six "Copied ..." snackbar strings and the
# two editor constraint-error strings ("Select at least one character set."
# and the "Length must be at least "/" to include every selected set."
# segments) must stay byte-identical.
